name: fld_finrank_adjoin_sqrt_two_add_sqrt_three
statement: : Module.finrank ℚ (IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ ({Real.sqrt 2 + Real.sqrt 3} : Set ℝ)) = 4
closed: Module.finrank ℚ (IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ ({Real.sqrt 2 + Real.sqrt 3} : Set ℝ)) = 4
informal: [ℚ(√2+√3) : ℚ] = 4 — IntermediateField.adjoin.finrank reduces to the degree of the minimal polynomial, which is X^4 - 10X^2 + 1; Uses Mathlib2.poly_x4_sub_10x2_add_1_irreducible_int (irreducibility over ℤ, hence over ℚ by Gauss) to identify the minimal polynomial.
